title: Capricor Therapeutics Deramiocel PDUFA Date Extended to November as FDA Reviews BLA Amendment
summary: Capricor Therapeutics (NASDAQ:CAPR) faces a three-month extension to the FDA review timeline for Deramiocel after the agency moved the PDUFA target action date for the Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy from August 22 to November 22, 2026. The extension follows Capricor’s submission of a major amendment containing 24-month open-label extension data from the Phase 3 HOPE-3 study and additional analyses supporting a refined proposed indication focused on upper limb function.
